name: Canóvanas (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Purple field with a wide yellow horizontal band across the centre, charged with the municipal arms and a scroll reading Canóbana del Cayniabón.
history: Canóvanas is a town and municipality in northeastern Puerto Rico. The gold and violet of the flag are taken from the banner of the association Hijos y Amigos Ausentes de Canóvanas; the arms recall the cacique Canóbana.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown and a scroll
